entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-05-30
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • XML docs completion lacking on extension blocks #78770
  • workspace.OpenSolutionAsync locked after update code analysis libraries on vs 17.14 #78766
  • RS1019 does not analyze suppression descriptions #78765
  • 'NullReferenceException' in 'Microsoft.Cci.MetadataWriter.CheckNameLength' on 'csc' invocation #78763

Closed

  • Compiler crash generating XML docs for extension #78768
  • C# Preview 10.0.100-preview.4.25258.110 Massive Compile Errors with Async Extension #78638
    Next
  • Any usage of extension indexers leads to CS0021 #78372
    Next
  • VS 2022 Preview Roslyn crashes when using a non-existent attribute after if followed by else on a new line #78749
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.main-10629.142 #78767

PullRequests

Created

  • Don't refresh dynamic files under a lock #78775
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Fix corruption of sliding text window when trying to peek backwards. #78774
    Area-Compilers
  • Exception Handler support #78773
  • Ensure sln load uses project absolute paths #78772
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Move off of a linear walk in solution-explorer symbol tree updates. #78771
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Update progression work to have context menu. #78754
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Move off of Progression for solution explorer. #78714
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Fix crash when determining if on header of invalid if-statement #78757
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Remove EditorFeaturesWpf TestComposition #78769
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Fix ILBuilder visualization #78764
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Fix cast before we unsubscribe #78776
    Area-IDE
  • Extensions: allow cref references to extension members #78735
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review
  • Extensions: Do not consider extension block methods as entry points, consider their implementation methods instead #78667
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Move Semantic tests to NetLatest #78453
    Area-Compilers, untriaged
  • Extensions: relax inferrability rule for methods #78758
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Extensions: mark skeleton type with 'specialname' #78690
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Implement compiler support for System.Runtime.InteropServices.ExtendedLayoutAttribute #78741
    Area-Compilers
  • Avoid dereferencing null CheckConstraintsArgs.CurrentCompilation #78729
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: ignore static/instance mismatches for properties inside nameof #78725
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Update referenced VS package versions #78689
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Disable TransitiveVersioningPinning for RoslynAnalyzers. #78747
  • Fix go to definition for conversions on invalid constructor overloads #78514
    Area-Compilers, Community, untriaged
  • Improve applicability to receiver type check for extension binary operators #78728
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Initial support for conditional logical binary extension operators #78706
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
